log.title: 🔔 Stock Finder alerts are on
log.text:
You will now get:
• Every weekday at about 4:30 PM: the plan for the next day - what to sell, what to buy - also on quiet days, so you always know the alerts work.
• 8:45 AM: a reminder, only when something must be bought or sold at the opening.
Why it was quiet: alerts came only for short trades, and none was allowed since 8 Nov.
Also new, after a test on 18 years of prices: the app sells everything only when the Nifty closes 3% below its 200-day average (fewer false alarms, smaller falls), and short trades are switched off (over 18 years they lost money after charges). Tap to open the app.
